facts.fact: The ministry convened stakeholders to review ongoing efforts to put in place a Government Enterprise Architecture, described as a common reference framework for coherence among public policies, processes, data, applications and the State's digital infrastructure, with the system inventory still to be drawn up; the document is dated 2026-08-03 and gives no event date.
